## Overview

This chapter demonstrates table styling across light and dark color schemes for both static and interactive tables.

## Static Tables with `gt`

The `gt` package produces publication-quality presentation tables. The theme overrides header borders, cell backgrounds, and text contrast in dark mode.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
library(gt)

head(iris, 6) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Iris Morphological Measurements",
    subtitle = "First 6 observations from the iris dataset"
  )
```

## Interactive Tables with `reactable`

The `reactable` package provides client-side sorting, searching, and pagination. Dark mode ensures full contrast for headers, alternating row striping, search inputs, and page buttons.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-reactable
library(reactable)

reactable(
  head(mtcars, 8),
  searchable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE
)
```
